tools.name: pitch-find-clubs
tools.description: Search the Southwest Pitch youth soccer club directory for Arizona, New Mexico, southern Nevada and El Paso. Filter by region, county or city, tier (Elite, Competitive, Recreational), league (for example ECNL, MLS NEXT, Girls Academy), gender, or free-text words. Returns each club's location, tier,

tools.name: pitch-list-areas
tools.description: The areas the Southwest Pitch club directory covers (Arizona, New Mexico, southern Nevada and El Paso), with the number of listed clubs in each. Use these names with pitch/find-clubs.

tools.name: pitch-search-guides
tools.description: Search published Southwest Pitch guides, articles and pages: tryouts, leagues, tournaments, camps, costs, gear, standings recaps and club spotlights.

tools.name: pitch-get-page
tools.description: Full text of one published Southwest Pitch page or article, as plain text with headings. Pass the URL or slug. Long pages come back in parts: pass next_offset as offset to continue.

tools.name: pitch-whats-new
tools.description: Articles and pages on Southwest Pitch published since a date (default: last 30 days), newest first: standings recaps, club spotlights, tryout and tournament updates.

tools.name: pitch-about
tools.description: What Southwest Pitch covers, the other Pitch Network regional sites, and how to cite it.
